name: translate-ai
title: Translate AI
description: Raycast extension to translate text using AI api
author: andrei_sianiuta

preferences.name: copyToClipboard
preferences.title: Copy to Clipboard
preferences.description: Automatically copy translated text to clipboard
preferences.label: Enable automatic clipboard copy

preferences.name: claudeApiKey
preferences.title: Claude API Key
preferences.description: Your Anthropic Claude API key (optional - provide either Claude or OpenAI key)

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Your OpenAI API key (optional - provide either Claude or OpenAI key)

commands.name: translate-ai
commands.title: Translate AI
commands.description: Translate text using Claude or ChatGPT. Auto-detects source language and optionally copies to clipboard.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
